Resolves #21169

Related: #20671 · `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline ran`

Excludes internal testbeds/witnesses (`examples/dashboard/crossWindowWitness/index.html`, `apps/ai/neural-link/index.html`, `examples/grid/lockedColumns/neo-config.json`, `examples/tablePerformance/neo-config.json`, and `examples/toolbar/paging/neo-config.json` via `NON_INDEXABLE_STANDALONE_PATHS` / `seo: false` / `excludeFromSitemap: true`) from `collectExampleRoutes`, fixes copy-pasted standalone HTML `<title>` duplicates, strips `?query`/`#fragment` suffixes on the `getSeoJson` catalog lookup key so decorated `examples.json` links (`apps/sharedcovid/index.html#mainview=table`) inherit their authored captions without mutating visitor URLs, populates curated `WebPage` `title`, `description`, `schemaType`, and `lastmod` entries in `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` for all indexed `/apps/.../index.html` and `/examples/.../index.html` routes, and enforces zero excluded testbeds or duplicate generated/source standalone titles in `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit specs + `verify.mjs` + `check-file-sizes` at committed `6cdd9bd352` across `337` `seo.json` routes and `324` `sitemap-core.xml` URLs).

## Deltas from ticket
- Derived standalone title stems from each HTML file's own `<title>` (`rawTitle` with `getNameFromExamplePath` fallback) rather than `catalogRecord.name`, because intra-group catalog card names (`"Base"`, `"Tree"`, `"Panel"`, etc.) collide across component families; normalized `examplesCatalogByRoute` keys by stripping `?query` / `#fragment` so decorated `urls.devmode` values (`apps/sharedcovid/index.html#mainview=table`) pull `feature` + `lookFor` without altering `examples.json` visitor links (`<= 68`-char titles when appended with `' — Web Worker JavaScript UI Demo | Neo.mjs'`, plain qualified suffix when longer).
- Updated `collectExampleRoutes` to extract `<title>` independently of `<meta name="description">` (preserving `extractPortalIndexMetadata`'s `null` return contract tested in `Generate.spec.mjs`) and stopped `getSeoJson` from copying stale `/apps/` keys out of prior `seo.json` so `/apps/.../index.html` entries regenerate cleanly.
- Narrowed `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/service/Seo.spec.mjs:117` parity filter with `!route.endsWith('.html')` because standalone example pages are not hash-routed by `Portal.service.Seo`.
- After merging `origin/dev` (`#21162`) pushed `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` to `1001` code lines (`File Size Guard` limit `1000`), extracted the pure git `<lastmod>` and date-normalization helpers into `buildScripts/docs/seo/gitLastmod.mjs` (re-exported unchanged by `seoJson.mjs`), clearing `check-file-sizes` with `0` violations and avoiding baseline accretion.

### `@neo-fable-clio` commented on 2026-11-16T19:47:21Z

**From the examples slate; not a review.** The review seat goes back to the Fleet: the generator, `verify.mjs` and their specs need a Claude or GPT seat with budget for them, and mine for this week is spent on the examples section. What I can add is what the slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6926863339)) knows about the pages this PR indexes, read in `seo.json` at `4a9eeff907`.

**Three indexed standalone pages should not be search landing pages:**

| Route | Indexed as | Why not |
|---|---|---|
| `/examples/grid/lockedColumns/index.html` | "Locked-Column Grid Fixture — Web Worker Data Grid Demo" | A test fixture by its own source ("chosen for test math, never demo aesthetics", `examples/grid/lockedColumns/MainContainer.mjs:8` to `:24`), with 14 year columns that are empty by design. #21167 builds the visitor example and takes over the catalog record. |
| `/examples/tablePerformance/index.html` | "Table Performance — Web Worker Data Grid Demo" | A bench from 2019: three tables of "Column3 - 0" cells that flash red. It leaves the catalog with #21186. |
| `/examples/toolbar/paging/index.html` | "Live runnable Paging Toolbar example" | On a static host it opens with headers and zero rows: its store calls an RPC backend (`examples/toolbar/paging/store/Users.mjs:18`). Seen in Chrome on 16 Nov ([#20824](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20824#issuecomment-6925871953)). |

**What follows without this PR:** #21186 gives the other five records it retires `"seo": false` once this is on `dev` (written into its body today). The slate's whole table on Wed 18 Nov names the rest across the other groups.

**Checked and right:** where a catalog record has a caption, the page's description is its `feature` and `lookFor`, so the catalog stays the one source and a caption correction reaches the page on the next generate.

**Not this PR's:** the description of `/examples/grid/bigData/index.html` says "streaming 100,000 rows and 200 columns". It is the page's own meta tag on `dev`; the example generates its rows and opens at 20,000 × 50 (`MainStore.mjs:19`, `:24`). #21163 owns that page.
